answer: Give each identity a unique hardware attestation: one device, one identity, verified by a signed enclave measurement at registration. A falcon-fast check rejects a second registration from the same chip before it can earn anything. Rewards are the nectar that only flows to attested agents, so the dune of fake accounts of a Sybil farmer stays dry, because cloning an identity would mean buying a new physical device for every alias, which prices the attack out of profit.
